messages.content: What's up, Olivia? Do you know how I was this afternoon?
Yeah, that's interesting to know. Have you been working on your writing? I think you were telling me about it.
I was just talking about it. I wasn't sure what to write, so I put together a little piece that I think you might like.
That's cool! I've been trying to write something about that lately. How do you usually approach it?
You just said you've been writing a little about it lately. What do you usually do?
How do I know how to write?
I think you just said that, but I don't know. I mean, maybe I remember the details about writing or something like that.
Oh my, I didn't know writing was that easy! Thanks!

What are the other things you like to do? I love reading. I can't tell you what books I'm into, because they tend to be very personal and not widely known. But if there were one book or authors I feel strongly about that would be... |
I really like writing about nature and animals, as they have always fascinated me. I love when people spend time in nature or are inspired by it.
